scope: One fixed-seed, three-arm planned P-CREW transfer at BASE-01. Both arms include the accepted C03 two-crew formation at h8 and one duplicate scheduled formation at h20. The control has an all-null ResourceTransfer placeholder. The out arm requests one busy crew out to <OUTSIDE> at h7.75. The out_in arm adds one <OUTSIDE> to BASE-01 arrival at h10.5. The second formation exposes whether the roster changes persist.

manual.rule: ResourceTransfer uses STFID, STTID, RID and TFTIME keys. <OUTSIDE> as target requests OUT and as source requests IN. TFQTY is the quantity and TFDT is travel delay for IN; a busy resource cannot transfer away until available.

frozen_delta: All three inputs derive byte-for-byte from accepted C03 staffing-2, add the same second OperationProfile row at STIM20, add a seven-column ResourceTransfer table, and change only the description and transfer rows across arms. Control has one all-null placeholder; out has one OUT row at h7.75; out_in adds one IN row at h10 with TFDT0.5.
acceptance_hypotheses: All three inputs import, roundtrip authored populated tables exactly, calculate and export usable native logs and reports with zero converter errors and only reviewed warning codes under guarded session-0 SSH.
The first h8 two-aircraft formation completes in all arms, and the h7.75 OUT request transfers only after busy crew becomes available.

At the second h20 formation, one remaining crew in out delays the formation relative to the two-crew control, while a completed IN in out_in restores control-like preparation and launch timing. Resource report bins and event logs reconcile with the transferred roster.
gate: Publish only if all frozen source pins, guarded native closure, exact authored populated-table roundtrips, independent event/report replay, first and second formation behavior, and OUT/IN times pass. Otherwise retain a diagnostic and freeze a new version.
execution_guard: Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, protected GUI PID13340/session1 identity, immutable run path, targeted child watchdog, source hashes before/after and raw SHA-256 closure.
limits: One fixed seed, one base, two aircraft, personnel P-CREW only, one OUT and one IN schedule. No BETWEEN transfer, equipment transfer, alternate resource policies, GUI, cross-engine parity or general I03/Issue #18 claim.
